title: Preallocate SHOW schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when DESCRIBE and SHOW CREATE TABLE build schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added show_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.

Replaced SHOW CREATE TABLE schema lookup key construction.

result: SHOW schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving DESCRIBE output, SHOW CREATE TABLE output, and broader DDL behavior.
